title: SUNDAY LIMBER
subtitle: SUNDAY MOBILITY. STILL BARKED. OPEN UP, OWN YOUR BALANCE, KEEP IT HONEST.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SUNDAY. SUNDAY LIMBER. FIFTEEN MINUTES. MOBILITY DAY. STILL BARKED. OPEN THE HIPS, OWN THE BALANCE, AND DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THE WEEKEND, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. SUNDAY LIMBER DONE. HIPS OPEN. BALANCE HONEST. ENJOY THE REST OF THE DAY, YOU EARNED A BIT OF IT.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET FLAT. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND LIFT SLOW. HOLD A BEAT AT THE TOP. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND HIP OPENER. NO RUSHING.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. SLOW UP. SQUEEZE. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE HIPS AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A LAZY TRAMPOLINE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE HIPS LOOSE.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: BACK FLAT. RIBS DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. CONTROL EVERY INCH. CORE STAYS QUIET AND HONEST.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. SLOW AND CONTROLLED. BACK FLAT. THIS IS YOUR CONTROLLED STRENGTH. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BEACHED HADDOCK.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR FOR BALANCE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TIP OVER LIKE A DRUNK ON PARADE.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUAT
exercises.cue: FEET SHOULDER WIDTH. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. HEELS DOWN. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. SMOOTH AND HONEST.
exercises.speakStart: SQUATS. TWO SETS OF TEN. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. HEELS DOWN. THIS IS YOUR LEG STRENGTH. DO NOT HALF-SQUAT LIKE YOU ARE SCARED OF THE CARPET.

exercises.name: CHAIR ROW
exercises.cue: HINGE AT THE HIPS. PULL ELBOWS BACK AS IF ROWING A HEAVY OAR. SQUEEZE THE SHOULDER BLADES. DESK POSTURE FIX.
exercises.speakStart: CHAIR ROWS. TWO SETS OF TEN. HINGE. PULL. SQUEEZE THE BLADES. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE STRENGTH. UNDO THAT DESK HUNCH, YOU SLOUCHING BASTARD.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: HIPS HIGH. DROP THE BOTTOM KNEE. FIVE SECONDS ONLY. BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER. NO SAG.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO HOLDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HIPS UP. SHORT AND HONEST. WE ARE BUILDING TOWARD TWENTY. NO SAGGING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
